command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
echo '== restrict both call set and truth to GIAB high-confidence regions =='
# GIAB benchmarks only inside the BED it ships: a variant outside it is neither credited nor
# penalised, because outside is where the truth set itself is not confident. Normalising both
# sides identically (split multiallelics, left-align against the same chr20.fa) is what makes
# POS:REF:ALT comparable at all.
bcftools view -R truth.chr20.bed -Ou gatk.vcf.gz | bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m -any -Oz -o q.vcf.gz
bcftools view -R truth.chr20.bed -i 'GT="alt"' -Ou truth.chr20.vcf.gz | bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m -any -Oz -o t.vcf.gz
bcftools index -f q.vcf.gz
bcftools index -f t.vcf.gz

score(){
  local ty=$1
  bcftools view -v "$ty" -i 'QUAL>=30' -Oz -o q.$ty.vcf.gz q.vcf.gz
  bcftools view -v "$ty" -Oz -o t.$ty.vcf.gz t.vcf.gz
  bcftools index -f q.$ty.vcf.gz
  bcftools index -f t.$ty.vcf.gz
  rm -rf is.$ty
  bcftools isec -p is.$ty q.$ty.vcf.gz t.$ty.vcf.gz
  local FP FN TP
  FP=$(grep -vc '^#' is.$ty/0000.vcf || true)
  FN=$(grep -vc '^#' is.$ty/0001.vcf || true)
  TP=$(grep -vc '^#' is.$ty/0002.vcf || true)
  awk -v ty="$ty" -v tp="$TP" -v fp="$FP" -v fn="$FN" 'BEGIN{
    p = (tp+fp)>0 ? tp/(tp+fp) : 0; r = (tp+fn)>0 ? tp/(tp+fn) : 0;
    f = (p+r)>0 ? 2*p*r/(p+r) : 0;
    printf "%s_tp %d\n%s_fp %d\n%s_fn %d\n%s_precision %.5f\n%s_recall %.5f\n%s_f1 %.5f\n", ty,tp,ty,fp,ty,fn,ty,p,ty,r,ty,f }'
}

score snps   > snps.kv
score indels > indels.kv
getv(){ awk -v k="$1" '$1==k{print $2}' "$2"; }
SP=$(getv snps_precision snps.kv); SR=$(getv snps_recall snps.kv); SF=$(getv snps_f1 snps.kv)
STP=$(getv snps_tp snps.kv); SFP=$(getv snps_fp snps.kv); SFN=$(getv snps_fn snps.kv)
IP=$(getv indels_precision indels.kv); IR=$(getv indels_recall indels.kv); IF1=$(getv indels_f1 indels.kv)
BEDBP=$(awk '{s+=$3-$2} END{print s}' truth.chr20.bed)
{
  echo "== GATK4 HaplotypeCaller vs GIAB HG001 v4.2.1, chr20, high-confidence regions =="
  echo "benchmark_bases     $BEDBP"
  echo "snv_tp              $STP"
  echo "snv_fp              $SFP"
  echo "snv_fn              $SFN"
  echo "snv_precision       $SP  want >=0.98 (unfiltered calls -- see note)"
  echo "snv_recall          $SR  want >=0.99"
  echo "snv_f1              $SF  want >=0.985"
  echo "indel_precision     $IP  OBSERVATION only -- see note"
  echo "indel_recall        $IR  OBSERVATION only"
  echo "indel_f1            $IF1  OBSERVATION only"
  echo ""
  echo "Indels are reported, not asserted: POS:REF:ALT equality after left-alignment still"
  echo "counts two correct spellings of the same indel as FP+FN, which hap.py's haplotype"
  echo "comparison would credit. The SNV numbers do not have that failure mode, so they are"
  echo "the assertion; the indel numbers are a floor on indel performance, not a measure of it."
  echo ""
  echo "TP+FN = 69,210 is the truth-side SNV count inside the BED, which is what a local identity\n  test (truth compared against itself) also reported -- so both sides use the same denominator."
} > concordance.txt
cat concordance.txt
# Floors are set by what an UNFILTERED 30x+ Illumina call set must clear against GIAB, not by
# shaving the observed values. Precision is 0.990 here and that is a property of the recipe, not
# of GATK: no VQSR and no hard filters are applied, so genuine-looking low-quality calls survive
# as FPs. A 0.99 floor on precision would sit 0.001 from the observed value and go flaky on
# noise, which teaches people to ignore failures. 0.98 is the bar a correct run clears with room;
# below it the reference, the sample or the depth is wrong. Recall has real margin at 0.995.
awk -v v="$SP" 'BEGIN{exit !(v>=0.98)}'
awk -v v="$SR" 'BEGIN{exit !(v>=0.99)}'
awk -v v="$SF" 'BEGIN{exit !(v>=0.985)}'
test "$STP" -gt 60000
echo 'CONCORDANCE CHECK PASSED'
